title: Separate Auritus web source into private Auritus-web repository
description: Create private AnthusAI/Auritus-web from the existing Auritus website and web console, preserving application behavior, routes, assets, branding, and design. Follow the actual Papyrus S3 and Markus architecture as verified from source, with GitHub Actions validation and deployment scaffolding only. Preserve the Auritus application repository and existing deployment. Acceptance: source repository exists privately; copied application retains its design and source provenance; separation and architecture decisions are documented; no deploy, AWS write, DNS change, credential change, or reauthentication occurs. Deployment migration is separate deferred work. Existing AWS sessions are expired; do not reauthenticate. Avoid builds due to limited disk space; report verification limits.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Source candidate is ready in private AnthusAI/Auritus-web; source task remains in progress until code is pushed. All 52 original tracked site files remain unchanged under legacy-site; 21 exported routes retained. Actual Papyrus commit 1138a614ec5d291f54850316429eb7aa8087cb8f and Markus 0.5.1 provide S3 publication through the real handler and renderer. Six scenarios / 23 steps and local projection (103 objects) passed, with cloud clients replaced by test doubles. Seven local browser checks passed; external APIs were aborted, no jobs created. No fresh Next build or dependencies installed due to limited disk. README records provenance, architecture, verification limits, and unfinished live migration/pipeline. Awaiting source commit from implementation agent before closing.

right_now_summary: The private repository is prepared, but the source commit is still pending.
